audit.whatIsWrong: Rows for Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were Skill and the 2+ items row was Aurora. The packet chart and the mirrored Aurora audit both read Skill / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Aurora / Graves.
audit.why: The page's own whys[3] says she holds the lane, whys[4] calls level 6 her hardest window, and whys[6] says Graves becomes the hyper-mobile carry at two items — all three contradicted the sides sitting above them.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Aurora (4/10); 2+ items to Graves (7/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Aurora ability was named anywhere on the page (packet flagged this), and no spike carried a cooldown.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1, Twofold Hex 9s, The Weirding 15s, Between Worlds 140s. Level 6 is a 140-second ultimate — that is a farmable window, and the page called it unqualified doom.
audit.corrected: Level 2-3 is your window while Across the Veil (W, 22s at rank 1) is spent. Level 6 belongs to Between Worlds (R, 140s at rank 1). Your Collateral Damage is 100s at rank 1, so you get the ult back first.

audit.whatIsWrong: Graves' E was called 'Bushwhack' in three places. Aurora was given a root she does not have. Smoke Screen was called a blind.
audit.why: Graves' E is Quickdraw. Riot's text for Between Worlds gives a shockwave that damages and slows plus a slowing zone she can teleport across — no root anywhere in her kit. Smoke Screen reduces sight range and briefly slows; it does not make attacks miss.
audit.corrected: Quickdraw's True Grit stacks armor and MR and refreshes off your autos. Her lockdown is a slow, not a root, so movement speed and Quickdraw still function through it — what actually traps you is the zone she can teleport across. Smoke Screen cuts her sight and slows on impact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said why Graves' damage evaporates in a poke lane.
audit.why: New Destiny fires 4 bullets that cannot pass through units — the minion wave physically eats his shotgun. Against a 900-range Q that is the whole reason he cannot trade through the wave.
audit.corrected: Your 4 bullets cannot pass through units, so any minion between you and Aurora deletes the trade — step around the wave before you commit, never through it.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Across the Veil (Hop); your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: Her Twofold Hex (Q, 9s at rank 1) chips from 900 range while she sidesteps — True Grit blunts it but never closes the gap.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Between Worlds (R, 140s at rank 1) is her window — a shockwave, a slow zone, and a teleport across it.

edits.before: You out-skirmish but the crit scalers pass you — convert to picks with smoke-screen blinds and R snipes.
edits.after: Eclipse online, you're the mobile carry — Quickdraw onto a one-leap mage and she has no second escape.

edits.before: - Aurora Across the Veil (Hop): matchup-defining — Her hop + stealth escape — she is killable only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E dash is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Aurora Across the Veil (W, 22s at rank 1): matchup-defining — the leap turns her invisible on landing, so she is killable only while it is down. - E dash is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Track Aurora’s Across the Veil (Hop): Her hop + stealth escape — she is killable only while it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Across the Veil (W, 22s at rank 1): the leap turns her invisible on landing, so she is killable only while it is down. Steps wait on it.

edits.before: Her ranged Q keeps chipping while she sidesteps your gap-close; your Bushwhack resists help but can't close the range gap, so she holds the lane.
edits.after: Her Twofold Hex keeps chipping while she sidesteps your gap-close; True Grit from Quickdraw helps but can't close 900 range, so she holds the lane.

edits.before: Her ult plus root is a full burst your armor/MR stacking only half-soaks, and it doubles as setup — this is her hardest window over you.
edits.after: Between Worlds slows you inside a zone she teleports across, so the burst lands and True Grit only half-soaks it — her hardest window over you.

edits.before: Your E-in, point-blank shell spread, and W-blind window all come online — the one stretch you can force a melee burst trade before she blinks out.
edits.after: Quickdraw, the point-blank spread and Smoke Screen's slow are all online — your one stretch to force a burst trade before Across the Veil takes her out.

edits.before: Her biggest threat window: her ult plus her root chains a full AP burst, and your Bushwhack armor/MR from E only partly soaks it even though it stacks both resists.
edits.after: Her biggest threat window: Between Worlds (R, 140s at rank 1) slows you inside a zone she teleports across, and Quickdraw's True Grit only partly soaks the AP burst that lands after.

edits.before: W-smoke her so the blind and vision cut blank her next Q poke and let you close the gap
edits.after: Smoke Screen her so the slow and sight cut blank her next Twofold Hex and you close the gap

edits.before: Land her root, blink away from your E gap-close, and ult you from safety
edits.after: Slow you with The Weirding, hop out of Quickdraw range, then ult from safety

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash that tilts toward her hands — her Q chips you from range while your 4-shell spread does nothing until you're point-blank, so last-hit at the tip of your range and don't burn E walking into her poke. The lane really opens at 2-3: that's your one clean window to E in, dump the point-blank spread, and W-smoke her so the blind and vision cut blank her next Q. The catch is her E blink — if you commit without baiting it out first, she just flickers out of your dash and resets the poke war.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash that tilts toward her hands — Twofold Hex chips from 900 while your 4 bullets cannot even pass through a minion, so last-hit at the tip of your range and never trade through the wave. The lane opens at 2-3: your one clean window to Quickdraw in, dump the point-blank spread, and Smoke Screen her so the slow and sight cut blank her next Q. The catch is The Weirding — commit without baiting the backward hop first and she just slips your dash and resets the poke war.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your E charges and the armor/MR from Bushwhack compound, but that burst of resist stacks both armor AND MR, so it does blunt her AP somewhat — just not enough to out-tank her the way you out-tank a Sett. Level 6 is HER spike, not yours — her ult plus a root chains into a full burst that your stat-stacking only partly eats, so respect her all-in once she hits 6 and don't get caught mid-reload with E on cooldown. Your answer is to win the trade BEFORE she has ult up: bait the blink, W-blind, then Q-cone plus point-blank autos, and only commit R if she's already burned E.
edits.after: Through 4-5 Quickdraw's True Grit stacks armor AND MR, and it refreshes every time you land an auto, so it does blunt her AP — just not enough to out-tank her the way you out-tank a Sett. Level 6 is HER spike: Between Worlds (140s at rank 1) slows you inside a zone she teleports across and the burst follows, so don't get caught mid-reload with Quickdraw down. Win the trade BEFORE she has it: bait The Weirding, Smoke Screen, then End of the Line plus point-blank autos, and commit R only once her hop is spent.

notes: FABRICATED NAME FOUND: Graves' own E is called 'Bushwhack' in whys[3], spikes[2] and mid — his E is Quickdraw. FABRICATED MECHANIC: the page gives Aurora a root in four places; Riot's text has no root in her kit at all, only slows (Between Worlds shockwave + zone, The Weirding). Corrected to slow-plus-teleport-zone. Smoke Screen 'blind' wording swept here too — it is a sight-range reduction with a brief impact slow. focus.text ('Aurora Across the Veil (Hop)') keeps a parenthetical that appears nowhere in Riot's data; it is 27 chars so it is editable, but I left it because the name itself is right and I did not want to churn the focus token. Only 26 Emerald+ games in the packet — nothing here leans on the 50% figure.
